user.title: Connect to Crestron Home Processor
user.description: Provide the connection details and Web API token for your Crestron Home Processor.

data_description.keypad_bridge_host: IP address of the Crestron processor running the Keypad Event Bridge driver. Leave blank to disable keypad event monitoring.
data_description.keypad_bridge_port: HTTP port configured in the Keypad Event Bridge driver (default: 9008).

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Crestron Home processor. Verify the IP address, port, and network status.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Verify the Web API token.

abort.already_configured: This Crestron Home processor is already configured.

init.title: Crestron Home Polling Options
init.description: Adjust the polling interval and select which device types to poll. Disabling unused endpoints reduces processor load.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to query the processor (10–300 seconds). Lower values give faster feedback but increase processor load. Default: 30 seconds.
data_description.poll_lights: Enable polling of /cws/api/lights for dimmer and switch loads.
data_description.poll_shades: Enable polling of /cws/api/shades for window coverings.
data_description.poll_thermostats: Enable polling of /cws/api/thermostats for HVAC/climate devices.
data_description.poll_sensors: Enable polling of /cws/api/sensors for occupancy, contact, and environmental sensors.
data_description.poll_scenes: Enable polling of /cws/api/scenes for lighting/shade scenes.
data_description.poll_doorlocks: Enable polling of /cws/api/doorlocks for lock devices.
